sentences.text: The scheme is known as the Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme for the General Public (SCSSGI).
It was introduced to provide financial security to senior citizens in India.
The primary objective is to encourage savings among senior citizens.
The scheme offers a regular income through interest payments.
The interest rate is set by the government and is subject to periodic revision.
The benefits include a safe investment option with a higher interest rate compared to regular savings accounts.
The scheme also provides tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act.
Eligibility is limited to Indian citizens aged 60 years and above.
Individuals aged 55 years and above who have opted for voluntary retirement can also apply.
The maximum investment limit is Rs. 15 lakhs.
The application process involves submitting a duly filled application form along with required documents.
Documents typically include proof of age and identity.
The scheme is available through designated banks and post offices.
The tenure of the investment is five years.
It can be extended for an additional three years after maturity.
The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Finance.
The scheme aims to provide financial independence and security to senior citizens.
